name: URTC-UPDATER
build: Detects local URTC projects, compares their manifests with GitHub and performs explicit install or update actions.
notes: Adapted from HYDRA-UMC-UPDATER's own proven design (the same atomic-by-verification staging-clone install/update, manifest discovery and evidence log), scoped to just the URTC ecosystem's own urtc.project.json/ecosystem: "URTC" repositories instead of HYDRA-UMC's. Every URTC repository is public, so remote discovery works with no GITHUB_TOKEN at all. Not yet run against a real URTC repository end to end.
